row:
Each CareerSighted video features a real person (not an actor) who really loves his/her career.  Consider this person your "Career Guide."  You'll learn what each career is really like and why the Career Guide loves going to work everyday.  It's virtual job shadowing!  From Horse Trainer to Attorney to Celebrity Makeup Artist, we cover a wide variety of careers so that you can discover a career you'll love!

Visit CareerSighted.com to watch the full videos, and "like" us on facebook.
